flaws.text: Technical Considerations and Related Work say "140's `fan_out`" (lines 81, 110), but 140's own slice plan says fan-out was relocated to initiative 180 (`140-slices.pipeline-foundation.md:158`, "Slice 159 (Fan-Out / Fan-In) relocated to initiative 180"; `180-slices.pipeline-intelligence.md:39` slice 182 `fan_out`), while the parent initiative plan says 320 is "Independent of 180" (`001-initiative-plan.squadron.md:44`). **VALID**: contradicts the parent plan and 140's documents. Needs: doc (sibling documents). Raised by the original review (F004).

note: Borderline: r11 finding 4 only says the fix is a "140/180-band change" and does not flag the misattribution, so not counted. r05 finding 4 and r10/r03/r01 treat fan_out as 140 or as existing without noting the 180 relocation, not counted. r04 finding 4 counted as it restates the 180 attribution.
